{{Top|leg}}
'''Crash foam''' was a synthetic [[Pearl/Legends|pearlescent]] foam-type substance that was used in some [[Starship/Legends|starships]]' crash deployment system. Once released, the foam buffered the occupants or contents of the ship against the impact and prevented compressive liquefaction.
